description:
Issue a time-limited, scope-limited key for a driver, valet, shop or buyer, signed Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87.
Returns a token (shown once) for the grantee. A 'history' key opens car_history. unlock / drive / trunk / valet /
service keys are credentials for hardware that checks them with car_key_check; Privi Car itself never opens
or starts a vehicle.

grantee.description: Who the key is for (stored only as a hash)
grantee.title: Grantee

hours.description: How long the key lasts, in hours (default 24, up to 366 days)
hours.title: Hours

not_before.description: Optional ISO 8601 start time; default now
not_before.title: Not Before

scopes.description: One or more of: history, unlock, drive, trunk, valet, service
scopes.title: Scopes

name: car_key_issue
title: Privi Car: issue a digital key
